title: The Moonlight Guardian's Sleepy Star Sweep

storyteller.name: Storyteller
storyteller.description: Warm, soothing adult storyteller who reads the book and answers the kids' questions

kid_older.name: Leo (Age 8)
kid_older.description: Curious 8-year-old who asks about the plot and loves guessing mysteries

kid_younger.name: Mia (Age 5)
kid_younger.description: Playful 5-year-old who notices funny and cute visual details, giggles and gasps

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Snuggle close for The Moonlight Guardian's Sleepy Star Sweep. Can you spot the sleepy star? Point, whisper, or just listen.

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: I’ll look very softly. Maybe a sleepy star needs a little pillow.

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: I’m ready to help our little guardian look.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: The Moonlight Guardian peeked out from a glowing blanket cape and saw three empty spots in the sky. Three little stars had dozed off somewhere!

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: “A little lift, a little tuck,” whispered the tiny helper, and up went the cape.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: One star was snoring in a cloud’s fluffy curl. The Guardian gave it a little lift and a little tuck, and its sky spot twinkled again.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: “Home and cozy,” whispered the Guardian—with a little yawn.

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: That cloud has a little star dent. Does the star need a tiny pillow? Can we tuck it in with one finger?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: The fluffy cloud was its soft resting place. Now it’s settled in its sky spot... You can make a tiny tuck with one finger, or just watch quietly.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Another star slept in the moon’s slipper, with one point poking out. A little lift, a little tuck—and its sky spot shone again.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: “Home and cozy,” whispered the Guardian, with a longer yaaawn.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: The last star made a tiny snuffle inside the Guardian’s own cape pocket. A slow little lift, a soft little tuck—and every sky spot twinkled.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: “Home and cozy,” breathed the Guardian, with the biggest ya-a-aawn.

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: Those eyelids look so heavy. Shall we give the tired guardian a quiet thank-you or a tiny goodnight wave?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Either is a kind choice. Every star is tucked into place now... Our guardian looks so sleepy. A quiet thank-you or a tiny wave can be gentle.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: With every star home, the Guardian floated down to bed before the sun woke. The glowing cape became a blanket: a little lift, a little tuck.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: “Home and cozy,” murmured the Guardian, and slept beneath the softly shining, sleeping stars.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Shall we rest our hands and whisper goodnight to our little guardian?

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: Goodnight, little guardian. Your blanket looks so cozy. <yawn>

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: Goodnight, stars. Everyone can rest now.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Rest well, little listeners. Please subscribe and come back for our next story.
